MINUTES

  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 8, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER

The Regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Tuesday, September 8, 2020, at 6:02 PM in the City
Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
The invocation was led by Councilmember Trimble.
FLAG SALUTE

 B.  CONSENT CALENDAR
Items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion
is desired, that item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and will be considered
separately.

1.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON
  THE AGENDA

  COUNCIL ACTION:  That the City Council waive reading in full of all
  ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which
  appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and
  further reading waived.

2.  FINANCE DEPARTMENT – TREASURER’S REPORT FOR JULY 2020.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Receive and file.

3.  FINANCE DEPARTMENT – WARRANTS PROCESSED DURING THE PERIOD
  OF AUGUST 15 TO AUGUST 28, 2020.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Receive and file.

4.  VARIOUS CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  •  August 25, 2020  -  Regular Meeting
  •  August 11, 2020  -  Regular Meeting
  •  July 28, 2020  -  Regular Meeting

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Receive and File.

It was moved by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember Maravilla, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to adopt the Consent Calendar in its entirety.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

  LIMITS PRIOR TO PREPARING THE GRANT APPLICATION PACKAGE FOR
  MEASURE R FUNDS FROM THE GATEWAY CITIES COUNCIL
  GOVERNMENTS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Approve to submit grant application document to the
  COG on the behalf of the City of Hawaiian Gardens.

Joe Colombo, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

8.  CONSIDER APPROVING A LETTER TO SUPERVISOR JANICE HAHN
  ENCOURAGING HER TO ALLOW OUTDOOR GAMING.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Provide staff direction.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, presented the staff report.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to approve sending a letter to all five LA County
Board of Supervisors and copy any other elected officials and create a digital letter for
residents and other supporters to sign in support.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carries 5-0.

9.  RESOLUTION NO. 077-2020
  AMENDING THE 2019-2021 CITYWIDE BUDGET AND YEAR ONE OF THE
  HG20-23 THREE-YEAR FINANCIAL PLAN.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Adopt Resolution No. 077-2020.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

 Councilmember Farfan and Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

Councilmember Maravilla recommends holding another Special Meeting for the budget.

10.  RESOLUTION NO. 076-2020
  A BUDGET AMENDMENT INCREASING THE SENIOR ADMINISTRATIVE
  ANALYST POSITION IN THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND/OR THE
  ADMINISTRATIVE TECHNICIAN POSITION IN COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
  TO FULL-TIME OR ELIMINATING ONE OR BOTH POSITIONS FROM THE
  AMENDED 2019-2021 CITYWIDE BUDGET AND YEAR ONE OF THE
  HAWAIIAN GARDENS THREE-YEAR FINANCIAL PLAN.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  (1) Adopt Resolution No. 076-2020 amending to the
  FY 2019-2021 Citywide Budget and year one of the HG20-23 Three Year
  Financial Plan, and direct staff to amend Exhibit A attached thereto and
  incorporated therein, to either:
  keep the Sr. Administrative Analyst and/or the Administrative Technician as full-
  time budgeted positions; OR eliminate the Sr. Administrative Analyst and/or the
  Administrative Technician positions from the budget entirely, subject to the meet-
  and-confer obligations of the Meyers-Milias Brown Act related to impacts of
  layoffs, if any.
  AND (2) As appropriate, direct the City Manager to meet-and-confer regarding
  the impacts of layoffs in the event the Sr. Administrative Analyst and/or the
  Administrative Technician positions are eliminated from the budget entirely.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

Councilmember Trimble spoke.

Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

Patrick Matson, Human Resources Manager, spoke.

Joe Colombo, Community Development Director, spoke.

It was moved by Mayor Alvarado, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, and approved
by roll call vote as follows to eliminate both the Senior Administrative Analyst and the
Administrative Technician positions.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, ALVARADO
NOES:  TRIMBLE, ROA
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carries 3-2. Mayor Pro Tem Roa and Councilmember Trimble opposed.

11.  DISCUSSION OF MITIGATION MEASURES TO  ALLEVIATE  SCHOOL

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Provide staff direction.

Ernie Hernandez, City Manager, spoke.

RECESSED

The City Council recessed at approximately 7:50 PM.

RECONVENED

The City Council reconvened at approximately 8:00 PM. All City Councilmembers were
present.

Councilmember Maravilla spoke.

Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, spoke.

Councilmember Trimble spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to request additional information from the ABC

12.  PROPOSITION OF A STOP SIGN AT THE INTERSECTION OF 221ST STREET
  AND CLARKDALE AVENUE.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Provide staff direction and authorize the City Manager

Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

14.  THIS AGENDA ITEM WAS MOVED TO A FUTURE MEETING DATE.

D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

Councilmember Maravilla explained the cost of the college banners and the reasoning
for to the residents.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

Councilmember Trimble requests to have members of the public to attend Council
meetings while maintaining safety measures.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, made comments
regarding the number of participants that bought banners.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, gave an update regarding the Governor Assembly Bill
33088.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Maravilla gave a summary regarding the Backpack Giveaway Event.

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, read the Closed Session Items into the record.

The City Council recessed at approximately 8:41 PM.

  SIGNIFICANT EXPOSURE TO LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT
  CODE SECTION 54956.9 (d)(2) & (e)(1)
  THE CITY COUNCIL, BASED ON EXISTING FACTS AND CIRCUMSTANCES,
